truyVan.khung: SELECT e.sbd, COUNT(*) AS so_su_kien, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.ngay_vn = ? THEN e.qid END) AS da_lam, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.ngay_vn = ? AND e.ket_qua = 1 THEN e.qid END) AS dung, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.ngay_vn = ? AND e.ket_qua =
truyVan.sql:
SELECT e.sbd,
       COUNT(*) AS so_su_kien,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.ngay_vn = ? THEN e.qid END) AS da_lam,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.ngay_vn = ? AND e.ket_qua = 1 THEN e.qid END) AS dung,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.ngay_vn = ? AND e.ket_qua = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM su_kien_hoc p WHERE p.sbd = e.sbd AND p.qid = e.qid AND p.ngay_vn < e.ngay_vn AND (p.ket_qua = 0 OR p.ket_qua IS NULL)) THEN e.qid END) AS len_bac,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.ngay_vn = ? AND e.ket_qua = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM su_kien_hoc p WHERE p.sbd = e.sbd AND p.qid = e.qid AND p.ngay_vn < e.ngay_vn AND p.ket_qua = 1) THEN e.qid END) AS tut_bac,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.ngay_vn = ? AND e.luc >= ? AND e.ket_qua IS NOT NULL THEN e.qid END) AS hien_thi_so_cau,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.ngay_vn = ? AND e.luc >= ? AND e.ket_qua = 1 THEN e.qid END) AS hien_thi_so_dung,
       GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN e.giay IS NOT NULL AND e.ngay_vn >= ? THEN e.giay END) AS giay_list
  FROM su_kien_hoc e
 WHERE e.sbd IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))
 GROUP BY e.sbd

truyVan.sql:
SELECT l.ma_ca, l.lan_thu, l.nop_luc, l.vao_luc, l.diem_i, l.diem_ii, l.diem_iii, l.tong, l.dap_an_json,
            COALESCE(c.ten_ca, '') AS ten_ca, COALESCE(c.lop, '') AS lop, c.thoi_gian_phut, c.cong_bo,
            c.bo_theo_em_json, c.so_cau_json,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chi_tiet_cau t WHERE t.ma_ca = l.ma_ca AND t.sbd = l.sbd AND t.lan_thu = l.lan_thu AND t.dung_sai = 0 AND NOT (t.phan = 'II' AND ((CASE WHEN substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),1,1) IN ('D','S') AND substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),1,1) = substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_dung,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),1,1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),2,1) IN ('D','S') AND substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),2,1) = substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_dung,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),2,1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),3,1) IN ('D','S') AND substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),3,1) = substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_dung,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),3,1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),4,1) IN ('D','S') AND substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),4,1) = substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_dung,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),4,1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) > 0)) AS so_cau_sai,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chi_tiet_cau t WHERE t.ma_ca = l.ma_ca AND t.sbd = l.sbd AND t.lan_thu = l.lan_thu AND t.dung_sai = 1) AS so_cau_dung,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chi_tiet_cau t WHERE t.ma_ca = l.ma_ca AND t.sbd = l.sbd AND t.lan_thu = l.lan_thu AND t.dung_sai = 0 AND t.phan = 'II' AND ((CASE WHEN substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),1,1) IN ('D','S') AND substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),1,1) = substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_dung,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),1,1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),2,1) IN ('D','S') AND substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),2,1) = substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_dung,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),2,1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),3,1) IN ('D','S') AND substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),3,1) = substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_dung,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),3,1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),4,1) IN ('D','S') AND substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),4,1) = substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_dung,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),4,1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) > 0) AS so_cau_mot_phan,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chi_tiet_cau t WHERE t.ma_ca = l.ma_ca AND t.sbd = l.sbd AND t.lan_thu = l.lan_thu AND t.dung_sai IS NULL) AS so_cau_trong,
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(((CASE WHEN substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),1,1) IN ('D','S') AND substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),1,1) = substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_dung,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),1,1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),2,1) IN ('D','S') AND substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),2,1) = substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_dung,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),2,1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),3,1) IN ('D','S') AND substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),3,1) = substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_dung,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),3,1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),4,1) IN ('D','S') AND substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_chon,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),4,1) = substr(replace(replace(upper(COALESCE(t.dap_an_dung,'')),'Đ','D'),'đ','D'),4,1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))), 0) FROM chi_tiet_cau t WHERE t.ma_ca = l.ma_ca AND t.sbd = l.sbd AND t.lan_thu = l.lan_thu AND t.phan = 'II') AS so_y_dung,
            (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(4), 0) FROM chi_tiet_cau t WHERE t.ma_ca = l.ma_ca AND t.sbd = l.sbd AND t.lan_thu = l.lan_thu AND t.phan = 'II') AS so_y_tong,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chi_tiet_cau t WHERE t.ma_ca = l.ma_ca AND t.sbd = l.sbd AND t.lan_thu = l.lan_thu AND 1 = 1) AS tong_cau
       FROM luot l
       LEFT JOIN ca c ON c.ma_ca = l.ma_ca
      WHERE l.sbd = ? AND (l.trang_thai = 'da_nop' OR l.trang_thai = 'khoa' OR l.nop_luc IS NOT NULL) AND c.trang_thai IS NOT 'da_xoa'
      ORDER BY l.nop_luc DESC LIMIT 100
